notes: Governmental funds on the modified cash basis (pp4-5, Total Governmental Funds column); business-type funds on the accrual basis (pp6-9, Total column; same figures as the Statement of Activities business-type column). Fund balances in the fund_balance fields (p5); ending_cash = sum of the governmental cash lines on the funds balance sheet (p4), certificates of deposit as ending_investments; no beginning cash printed. Governmental transfers are printed only as a net 'Transfers in (out)' per fund; the Total column net (79,949) is recorded as transfers_out. Bond proceeds 819,000 are printed among revenues (Flood Control Fund) and are a receipt line. Business-type receipts total = operating revenues + nonoperating interest income (no single printed total); disbursements total = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses (p2, = operating expenses + interest expense + loan fees). 'Other revenue' is counted in the Statement of Activities Charges for Services, so charges for services/fees. Detail: General Fund from the departments schedule (pp16-17; supersedes the General Fund budget schedule p10, not recorded); Cemetery and Recycling departments are under Public works on p10 and are categorised to match the statement's Public works line. Street, Golf Board, Flood Control and Debt Service funds from their budget schedules (pp11-14; zero-actual budget-only lines such as Street bond proceeds and capital outlay are not recorded); six nonmajor funds from the combining statement (p15); utility funds from the proprietary statement fund columns (p7; no utility budget schedules in the trim); nonoperating lines outside each fund's printed operating total.
